subject: SOURCE-COMPUTER paragraph
notes: kb/Work PB78 (2026-08-18) + PB830 (2026-09-22). RENDERED from the printed page (PDF p314 / folio 284): SOURCE-COMPUTER. [computer-name-1] . and nothing else; SR1 (no name -> the second period may be omitted) is the PB78 witness. The format is CLOSED since PB830: what follows the name used to be a `~DOT` token SINK (the computer-attributes sink), kept for the deleted '85 WITH DEBUGGING MODE and never gated, so `SOURCE-COMPUTER. IBM-370 WIBBLE WOBBLE.` compiled and ran at every edition (the previous CONFORMS witness answered a different question - the optional name). The '85 clause is now a modelled rule (`debuggingModeClause`, gated debugging-mode-removed-2002 at its node) and the residue is the `unrecognizedClause` error production, refused by name as COBOL1970 at every edition (the negative).
